verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Framer's code-based, declarative animation system lets designers build data-driven, near-production prototypes (framer-comm-4, framer-comm-5, framer-comm-2), but hands-on reports also document real animation quality issues — intermittent frame-rate chugging and visual distortion of rounded corners/borders during size-change animations (framer-comm-6, framer-comm-7). The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation specifically describing state-based animation, conditional logic/variables, or scroll-effect authoring (all docs items focus on AI agents, CMS, and publishing pipelines instead). Missing for 10: vendor docs on interaction/animation/variables/scroll-effect features, resolution or acknowledgment of the reported animation glitches, and independent benchmarks beyond a couple of forum threads.
